verdict.rationale: Intel markets Copilot+ integration enabling voice commands to 'get answers, edit content, and turn ideas into reality' (docs-7, docs-15), which resembles delegating tasks to an AI assistant, but this assistant is Windows/Copilot+ software running atop Intel hardware, not an assistant built into the chip itself, and there's no independent evidence of actual agentic task delegation. missing for 10: evidence of an Intel-native assistant (not just OS-level Copilot+) actually executing delegated multi-step tasks, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this behavior.
